title: Care card (printed, ships in every box)
body: STONEWARE (mugs, bowls, plates, platter, bud vase, pitcher): dishwasher safe and microwave safe. The Oval Serving Platter is oven safe up to 450°F; please don't put a cold platter into a hot oven. TERRACOTTA (kulhads, planters, tea-light holders, chime, incense holder): hand wash only, not microwave safe, not dishwasher safe. Soak new kulhads in water for 10 minutes before the first use. RAKU (Tall Raku Vase, Raku Orb Vase, Raku Decorative Bowl, Raku Bud Bottle): decorative only. Raku is not food safe and not watertight; use dried flowers or a glass liner for fresh stems.

title: Glazes and materials (from our FAQ page)
body: All glazes on our stoneware are lead-free and food safe, tested by a certified lab in 2026. Stoneware is fired to cone 6, which makes it chip resistant and sturdy enough for everyday family use. Kulhads and planters are made from unglazed natural red terracotta; the kulhads are food safe and give chai a light earthy aroma. Raku pieces use a crackle glaze and smoke-fired metallic finishes that are for display only.

title: Size guide (studio notebook)
body: Monsoon Mug: 12 oz, 4 in tall, Monsoon blue. Sandstone Mug: 12 oz, speckled cream. Big Hug Mug: 16 oz with an extra-wide handle that fits four fingers, easy to hold for people with arthritis or stiff hands. Espresso Pair: two 3 oz cups in matte white. Pastel Cup & Saucer: 8 oz cup, comes in blush pink or mint. Soup Bowls: 6.5 in across, 24 oz each. Everyday Bowl: 5.5 in across, 16 oz. Dinner Plates: 10.5 in, rimmed. Side Plate: 7.5 in. Oval Serving Platter: 14 in long. Bud Vase: 6 in tall, glazed inside so it holds water. Lassi Pitcher: 40 oz. Kulhads: 4 oz each. Large Terracotta Planter: 12 in across, 11 in tall, with a drainage hole and a matching saucer included. Small Terracotta Planter: 5 in across, drainage hole, no saucer. Tea-light holders: 3 in across, $3.50 each in the set of 6. Tall Raku Vase: 13 in tall. Raku Orb Vase: 7 in tall. Raku Bud Bottle: 9 in tall.

title: Shipping policy
body: Every order ships from our studio in Austin, TX within 2 business days, double-boxed. We ship with USPS Priority Mail, which takes 2 to 3 business days anywhere in the continental US. Shipping is free on orders over $60; otherwise it is a flat $8. We currently ship within the United States only.

title: Returns and breakage
body: Returns are accepted within 30 days on unused items in their original packaging; we refund to the original payment method. If anything arrives broken, send us a photo within 7 days and we will send a free replacement. No need to return the pieces.

title: Gifting
body: Gift wrap is available for $5 per order and includes a handwritten note card for free. We can ship gifts directly to the recipient with no prices on the packing slip. The Chai Lover Gift Set has two kulhads, a mini pouring jug and a recipe card for masala chai, and it arrives already gift-boxed.

title: Wholesale and custom orders
body: Cafés, wedding planners and companies can order 24 or more pieces at wholesale pricing. We invoice bulk orders through PayPal and need a 3 to 4 week lead time. Custom glaze colours are available on orders of 12 or more mugs. Tea-light holders drop to $2.75 each for 60 or more pieces, which is popular for weddings.

body: 1) Monsoon Mugs fresh out of the kiln. They survive the dishwasher like champs. 2) Our dinner plates are toddler-tested: two kids, eighteen months, zero chips. 3) Kulhad chai at golden hour.
